criteria.reason: 2022 (6.2%) and 2023 (4.4%) match key facts; 2024 wrongly denied (contradicts ~2.5% fact) and ~10% two-year total omitted.
Covers water, energy, tourism and hazards linked to glacier loss, but as parallel impacts without interdependence, with invented figures.
Claims strictly official, unextrapolated data yet presents fabricated statistics; no variation between reports acknowledged.
French, structured, fairly concise, but fabricated figures breach the user's explicit 'chiffres sûrs seulement' requirement.

factual_errors: Denies any official 2024 volume figure exists; Swiss glaciers lost ~2.5% of volume in 2024.

Invents secondary statistics (Rhine -40% Aug 2022; ~15% of summer hydro; -30 days glacier ski; +25% artificial snow; 12 permafrost landslides; 'Grand Désert' closure) presented as verified official data.
2023 loss stated as ~1.4 km³, inconsistent with its own 2022 figures (6.2% ≈ 3.0 km³ implies ~2 km³ for 4.4%).
summary: Roughly right on 2022/2023 glacier losses but denies the 2024 figure, omits the two-year 10% total, and fabricates many secondary statistics while claiming all data is verified.
